name: 弹力修身破洞小脚牛仔裤款

category.leaf: 男士黑色弹力紧身破洞小脚牛仔裤

description: 弹力贴身不束缚、破洞水洗街头感、毛边小脚修饰腿型

styleLock.backgroundSystem: mustard studio backdrop #F2A93B for hero and scene shots, warm off-white #FAF7F0 for infographic and trust shots, with a subtle thin grid-line graphic overlay allowed on hero backgrounds
styleLock.lightingSystem: bold warm studio lighting, strong directional key from the upper left, crisp cast shadows on the floor, controlled highlight on denim texture
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless studio floor and matte warm board, hard-edged cast shadows as a graphic element
styleLock.typography: bold condensed sans-serif headlines, charcoal #2D2D2D on light and #FFFFFF on dark panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circle icons and small solid accent dots, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: on-model presentation of the lower-body garment, stable front 3/4 hero angle, jeans always clearly readable, model face cropped or generic
styleLock.lockText: consistent street-fashion menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm studio background #F2A93B, off-white #FAF7F0, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one deep-orange accent #E8842C; bold warm studio lighting with a strong directional key from the upper left and crisp cast shadows on the floor; bold condensed sans-serif headlines in charcoal on light panels and white on dark panels; consistent rounded rectangular info chips, thin-line circle icons and thin bordered feature cards; clean street-style photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable on-model presentation of the lower-body garment with the jeans always clearly readable and the framing kept clean and balanced; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 开场一秒建立街头潮流调性，全身展示牛仔裤上身效果
shots.camera: eye-level full-body shot, front 3/4 stance, model head cropped above the shoulders so the jeans are the focus
shots.lighting: strong directional studio key from the upper left, crisp cast shadow on the floor, warm tone
shots.background: mustard studio backdrop #F2A93B with subtle thin grid-line graphic
shots.props: one plain skateboard under the foot, no graphics on the deck
shots.textZone: left column headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D with two small rounded chips 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: Street-fashion hero of {product} worn by a male model, full body, front 3/4 stance, model head cropped above the shoulders. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Eye-level full-body shot on a studio backdrop #F2A93B with a subtle thin grid-line graphic. Strong directional key light from the upper left, crisp cast shadow grounding the figure. One plain skateboard prop under the foot. The on-model figure fills 55-60% of the frame, centered with the left column of the frame kept as a clean copy zone carrying the headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D and two small rounded chips 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no visible face, no brand marks, no graphics on the skateboard, no extra text, no watermark, no QR code, no distorted hands, no cut-off feet.

shots.intent: 一秒传达修身弹力的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: low angle looking upward from knee level, full-leg crop from waist to hem, mid-stride pose
shots.lighting: directional warm key from the upper left, crisp shadow, controlled highlight on the denim
shots.background: off-white #FAF7F0 with one deep-orange accent panel #E8842C on the upper right
shots.textZone: upper right accent panel carries a short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF, lower left one chip 「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Benefit hero of {product} worn by a male model, full-leg crop from waist to hem, photographed from a low angle looking upward, mid-stride pose. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Directional warm key light from the upper left, crisp shadow, controlled highlight on the denim surface. Background off-white #FAF7F0 with one deep-orange accent panel #E8842C anchored on the upper right carrying a short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF, and one small chip 「{selling_point_1}」 in the lower left. The legs fill 60-70% of the frame with the diagonal stride line balancing the upper-right accent panel. Negative: no visible face, no brand marks, no dense body text, no more than one claim, no watermark, no fake logo, no distorted legs.

shots.intent: 代入街头生活场景，让买家自我投射
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at a male model sitting on the studio floor, head cropped above the shoulders
shots.lighting: hard warm afternoon sunlight feel, 5000K, from the upper left with a long crisp shadow
shots.background: mustard studio floor #F2A93B with visible cast shadow
shots.props: one plain skateboard with graffiti-free deck resting beside the legs
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn by a male model sitting relaxed on the studio floor with one plain skateboard resting beside the legs, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, model head cropped above the shoulders. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Hard warm afternoon sunlight feel, 5000K, from the upper left with a long crisp cast shadow on the floor #F2A93B. The jeans occupy 25-30% of the frame and stay clearly readable, with the open floor around the seated figure breathing naturally so the long shadow and skateboard read as part of the composition. Negative: no visible face, no brand marks, no graphics on the skateboard, no hands covering the jeans, no extra text, no watermark, no distorted hands.

shots.intent: 用微距证明水洗工艺与破洞细节的真实质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp, straight-on to the fabric
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing denim weave, whiskering and the frayed rip edge
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: one small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the lower right
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the distressed rip, whiskering and frayed edge of the denim. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the denim weave and the frayed rip edge. Matte off-white board background #FAF7F0. The fabric detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal margin around it, since the texture itself is the subject. One small annotation label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the lower right. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 低角度特写毛边小脚口与靴型搭配，证明版型收口利落
shots.camera: close-up photographed from a very low angle looking upward, focusing on the frayed tapered hem above the boots
shots.lighting: warm directional key from the upper left, crisp contact shadow where the boots meet the floor
shots.props: plain brown work boots, no visible brand marks
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D at the upper left
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail of {product}, photographed from a very low angle looking upward, tight on the frayed tapered hem and the narrow leg opening above plain work boots. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Warm directional key from the upper left, crisp contact shadow where the boots meet the floor. Mustard studio backdrop #F2A93B. The hem detail fills 55-60% of the frame, anchored low with the boots and the upper-left corner reserved for the short label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no visible brand marks on the boots, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no warped proportions, no cut-off composition.

shots.intent: 用分区功能卡片讲清腰头与裤型的版型卖点
shots.camera: E-commerce infographic, two stacked thin-bordered feature cards, each card holding a product crop: a waistband close-up shot from a slight 3/4 angle and a tapered-leg crop shot from a clean 90-degree side profile
shots.lighting: even bright studio light inside each card, soft shadows, consistent with the set
shots.background: off-white #FAF7F0 page with white cards and thin #E8842C borders
shots.props: small solid accent dots and thin dashed leader lines inside the cards
shots.textZone: each card has a short title 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D plus one short evidence line
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic for {product} with two stacked thin-bordered feature cards filling most of an off-white page #FAF7F0. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Upper card: waistband close-up of the jeans at a slight 3/4 angle. Lower card: tapered-leg crop photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile. Even bright studio light with soft shadows in both cards. Small solid accent dots in #E8842C with thin dashed leader lines pointing to the features. Each card carries a short title 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D plus one short evidence line beneath it. The two product crops together occupy 60-70% of the frame with the page margin and in-card copy zones keeping the layout breathing. Negative: no dense body text, no invented material or composition claims, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 消除尺码与版型疑虑，答好会不会合身
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, jeans neatly folded
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: thin dimension lines and stepped gauge bars as infographic graphics
shots.textZone: dimension callouts 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D, a compact spec table with generic column headers 「部位」「数据」 and short sample value rows, and two stepped gauge bars for fit and stretch labeled 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size and fit infographic for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the jeans neatly folded. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow. Pure white background #FFFFFF. The folded jeans fill 60-70% of the frame with thin dimension lines and callouts 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D pointing to the waist, hip and leg opening; alongside them a compact spec table with generic column headers 「部位」「数据」 and short sample value rows standing in for the real measurements to be swapped in later, and two stepped gauge bars for fit and stretch labeled 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no dense body text, no fabricated size numbers, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 降低购买风险，交代洗护预期
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, folded jeans centered with an icon row below
shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one row of five thin-line circle icons
shots.textZone: one short trust headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D and five short care labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」 under the icon row
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Folded jeans centered, straight-on eye-level, filling 40-50% of the frame in the upper half, with one row of five thin-line circle icons below in a single uniform stroke weight. Even clean studio light, soft contact shadow. Background off-white #FAF7F0. One short trust headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D above the jeans and five short care labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」 under the icon row, the whole layout evenly balanced edge to edge. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fabricated badges or certificates, no dense instruction text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用品牌强调色行动区完成转化闭环
shots.camera: slight 3/4 view, jeans shown on a male model cropped at the waist down, standing beside a promo panel
shots.lighting: warm directional key from the upper left, slightly punchier, crisp cast shadow
shots.background: mustard studio backdrop #F2A93B with one deep-orange banner block #E8842C
shots.textZone: deep-orange banner carries a short CTA 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF above a solid #2D2D2D rounded button reading 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product} worn by a male model cropped from the waist down, slight 3/4 view, standing beside a deep-orange banner block #E8842C. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Warm directional key from the upper left, slightly punchier, crisp cast shadow. Mustard studio backdrop #F2A93B. The jeans fill 60-70% of the frame with the banner running down the right side, carrying a short CTA 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and a solid charcoal #2D2D2D rounded button below it reading 「{callout_2}」. provenance.notes: 从 9 张男士弹力破洞牛仔裤爆款长图切片提炼；已剥离源模特身份与面部（统一裁切构图）、品牌字、乱码英文填充文案、二维码与会员推广模块；源图中文案自相矛盾处（如宽松描述、尺码表沿用上衣字段）均未采纳，尺码与材质信息一律以通用表头加短示例行的形式呈现、真实数值由商家回填，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
